{"code": "import numpy as np

# Confirm the total number of patients
total_patients = len(df)

# Count how many are sentinel values (i.e. -999.0)
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()

# Check if any other sentinel values might exist (e.g. NaN, 0, etc.)
missing_count = df['biomarker_baseline'].isna().sum()

# Show the actual distribution of baseline values
baseline_values = df['biomarker_baseline']

# Exclude sentinel values (replace them with NaN) and compute mean
mean_baseline = baseline_values.replace(-999.0, np.nan).mean()

# Return the counts and the mean
total_patients, sentinel_count, missing_count, mean_baseline"}
